The '''Brotherhood vendor''' is a [[Protectron (Fallout 76)|Protectron]] operating at [[The Whitespring Resort]] in [[Appalachia]].

==Background==
The Brotherhood vendor is found in the Whitespring Mall's Creekside Lodge store along with [[Cunningham (Fallout 76)|Cunningham]]. He sells a variety of items, including mod plans for [[Power armor (Fallout 76)|T-series power armor]].

Slocum's Joe (Watoga).content:
{{Infobox location |games =FO76 |type =unmarked |image =FO76 Watoga SP 8.png |part of =[[Watoga Shopping Plaza]] |map marker image =Watoga map.png |signage =FO76 Slocum Joe Watoga sign.png |owners =[[Slocum's Joe (company)|Slocum's Joe]] {{small|''(pre-War)''}} |cell name =WatogaShoppingPlazaExt |refid = |editor id = }} '''Slocum's Joe''' is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in the [[Appalachia]]n city of [[Watoga]]. ==Background== A coffee shop in [[Watoga Shopping Plaza]], having served the affluent citizens of the town before the [[Great War]]. The [[Slocum's Joe (company)|Slocum's Joe]] location offered items such as cranberry lattes.''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide]]'', p. 499: ''"'''SLOCUM'S JOE'''''
''There's no coffee on the boil anymore, but there's some reasonable tinned food to scavenge, as well as a possible Magazine in the rack."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia#SLOCUM'S JOE|Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) ==Layout== The store is accessible, within the plaza on the northeastern part of town. The storefront's entrance faces outward towards the perimeter walkway. It is situated next to [[Stuart's Department Store]] and [[Miller's Appliances]], sharing a patio containing tables and chairs. The interior has coffee makers behind the front counter and a seating area for patrons consisting of tables and chairs. ==Notable loot== * [[Enola Walker's story, part 4]] - Holotape, in the red bandstand pavilion east of Slocum's Joe, next to a first aid kit. * Two potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazines]]: ** On the table with a yellow plate. Sometimes spawns below the table. ** On a yellow magazine shelf behind the front counter, on the top righthand row. * Potential [[Fallout 76 recipes|recipe]] - To the right of the coffee makers behind the counter. ==Appearances== The Watoga Slocum's Joe appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== FO76 Watoga SP 4.png FO76 New Watoga 17.png FO76 New Watoga 20.png FO76 New Watoga 15.png FO76 New Watoga 16.png FO76 New Watoga 12.png FO76 New Watoga 30.png ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Watoga locations]] [[Category:Slocum's Joe locations]] [[ru:Кафе «Джо Слокам» (Ватога)]]

'''Sunny''' is a pet [[Cat (Fallout 76)|cat]] living inside [[the Foundation supply room]] in [[Appalachia]] {{in|FO76SD}}.

==Background==
Sunny the cat roams the supply room. Sunny has a small corner in the room with a sleeping mat, a [[Cat bowl (Fallout 76)|cat bowl]], and a [[Toy rocketship (Fallout 76)|toy rocketship]].
